discription: A percussive pluck sound generated by a decaying saw wave with an ADSR envelope. Good for short, punchy basslines or rhythmic elements.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, decTime=0.5;var sig;var env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.001, decTime, 0.0, 0.1, curve: -4),gate: gate,doneAction: 2);sig = Saw.ar(freq) * amp * env;Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
